svg.title: Execute the gain and validity policy against the same exposure history
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Execute the gain and validity policy against the same exposure history
Pulse from 0 to 10 μs; H is restored after 20 μs quiet dwell
Residual allowance is checked after restoring the high-gain calibration
H returns at 30 μs; first valid 1 μs-grid output is 186 μs (176 μs after pulse).
Low gain is safer downstream but wanted −76 dBm fails the −60 dBm visibility floor.
Input protection is a separate physical contract; an invalid flag does not protect hardware.
State coefficient, pulse history and exposure qualification accompany every valid record.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
